title: Centering Prayer online (weekly)
description: Centering prayer online, via Zoom. Esther arrives at 11:50 to greet participants.

title: Contemplative Living in Today's World
location: Dominican Center, 1700 Fulton St. E, Grand Rapids, MI
description: Join us one Sunday each month for a welcoming community for those seeking to cultivate a more contemplative spiritual life. Together, we will explore contemplative practices, the wisdom of the Christian mystical tradition, sacred conversation, silence, and reflection to recognize God's presence within ourselves, within one another, and throughout all creation.

title: Centering Prayer, in person (weekly)
location: Catholic Information Center, close to St. Andrews Cathedral
description: Our meetings start with personal prayers, then we Center for 20 minutes. After a short break, we typically watch a short video related to Centering or Contemplative prayer. The balance of the meeting time is spent discussing the video.
